## Risk and data
- [ ] Personal data: does this collect, store or show anyone's personal data? If yes, say what, where it's kept and for how long (Governance or Guardian reviews)
- [ ] Touches auth, row-level security or uploads (Guardian reviews)
- [ ] Money: touches payments, or switches Stripe from test to live? Going live needs Devonte's sign-off
- [ ] Public text: adds claims, prices or legal wording such as privacy, terms or refunds (Governance reviews)
- [ ] Company details: Nexus sites show the company name, number and registered office; personal apps show none
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens or real user data in code, logs, fixtures, screenshots or this description
- Rollback plan:

## Support impact
- [ ] Changes something users see or fixes a reported case. If so, link the case (SC-NNNN) and note what support needs to update (help text, known issues, reply template)

## Review
- [ ] Evidence posted in #nexus-reviews
- [ ] Not pushed between 9am and 5pm UK on weekdays unless Devonte agreed
